explication: Open Micro-Manipulator is a USB-serial-controlled XYZ micro-manipulator. Its principal workflow is a host sending G-code through the Python API; firmware parses commands, plans motion, evaluates joint-space trajectories, and drives closed-loop actuators. Homing, joint calibration, and timed tool outputs are additional device capabilities. The tree and README establish these product areas, while sampled source confirms parser dispatch, firmware update-loop calls, trajectory evaluation, servo feedback, and homing behavior. Robot orchestration and several subsystems are unsampled, so their internal wiring is shown only where documented, not inferred in detail.
